# Third-party sources

`stb_truetype.h` is stb_truetype 1.26 from the official
[`nothings/stb`](https://github.com/nothings/stb) repository, pinned at commit
`2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20`.

It is intentionally kept in upstream form and is excluded from Native's local
C++ formatting and file-length conventions. Its dual public-domain/MIT terms
are reproduced in `STB-LICENSE.txt` and at the end of the header.

The message-box PNGs under `bootstrap-icons/message-box/` and generic file
and folder PNGs under `bootstrap-icons/filesystem/` are derived from
the official [`twbs/icons`](https://github.com/twbs/icons) repository, pinned
at commit `6945b7006285d444cc17ff2e22c7691719229526`. Their source mapping,
rasterization details, attribution, and MIT license are recorded in
`bootstrap-icons/README.md` and `bootstrap-icons/LICENSE`.
